newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GE appoints chairman for China operation.
newsitem.headline: GE appoints chairman for China operation.

text.p: General Electric Co said on Thursday it appointed David Wang as chairman and chief executive officer of GE China, effective immediately.
Wang will be responsible for leading the firm's business development and other activities in China, it said in a statement.
He succeeds Mei Wei-cheng, who was recently appointed president and regional executive of GE Appliances Asia Operation.
GE said it has 21 joint ventures and wholly owned companies in China with total assets of more than US$1.1 billion.
